questions.q: Where does the artifact store for a SageMaker managed MLflow tracking server live?
options: Inside the SageMaker service account, invisible to you
On the laptop that ran the notebook
In an S3 bucket in your own AWS account
In the CloudWatch console
questions.explain: The tracking server's compute and metadata store are hosted by SageMaker, but the artifact store is an S3 bucket you own, in the same Region as the server.

questions.q: How does your Python code connect the MLflow client to a SageMaker tracking server?
options: mlflow.set_tracking_uri with the tracking server ARN, using the sagemaker-mlflow plugin
Emailing the run IDs to the server
Uploading mlruns to the SageMaker console
Setting the experiment name only
questions.explain: The AWS MLflow plugin authenticates requests with AWS Signature Version 4 and lets you connect using the tracking server's ARN.

questions.q: Two runs used identical parameters and gave identical scores. What does experiment tracking let you conclude?
options: The model is perfect
Random seeds are irrelevant
The metric is broken
One of the runs was probably redundant compute
questions.explain: With parameters and metrics logged side by side, repeated configurations become obvious, so you can avoid paying for duplicates.

questions.q: Which of these is best stored as an MLflow tag rather than a metric?
options: Validation loss at each epoch
The data version, such as churn-v1
Training accuracy
Number of trees
questions.explain: Tags hold descriptive labels such as data version, owner or purpose. Numeric results are metrics, and settings are parameters.

questions.q: What does the SageMaker developer guide now recommend for new experiment tracking work?
options: The SageMaker Experiments Python SDK in Studio Classic
The new Studio experience with MLflow
Spreadsheets stored in S3
Printing metrics to the notebook
questions.explain: The guide says SageMaker Experiments SDK tracking is only available in Studio Classic and recommends the newer Studio experience with the MLflow integration.
